tools.name: list_modules
tools.description: List ACI Risk Indicator modules: each module's `code`, `name` and `description`, with full results adding live provider counts and criteria counts. Access: no sign-in needed. Signed out and below the Professional plan, it returns each module's `code`, `name` and `description` only, with no provider

tools.name: search_providers
tools.description: Search ACI providers by free text and/or module, risk band, or subtype. Full results cover providers with a current ACI Risk Indicator, with headline fields for each match: `slug`, `name`, `module`, the indicator value (`score`), `risk_band` and `subtype`. tools.name: get_risk_score
tools.description: Get the current ACI Risk Indicator for one provider, by slug or name. Every answer carries `score_status`: `PUBLISHED` with the indicator, or, for a provider with no current indicator, `WITHHELD`, `RETIRED`, `AWAITING_CERTIFICATION` or `NOT_ASSESSED` with `score_status_message` and no value or band.

tools.name: get_provider_detail
tools.description: Get the full breakdown of one provider's current ACI Risk Indicator: per-criterion values, weights, weighted contributions, confidence and hard caps, plus the stress classification where one is stored. tools.name: compare_providers
tools.description: Compare 2–5 providers side by side: full details plus a per-criterion comparison matrix. Access: Professional plan and above. If the user is not signed in, calling this tool starts the sign-in to their Aethon Credit Intelligence account.

tools.name: assess_portfolio_risk
tools.description: Assess the composite risk of an allocation of 2–20 providers (weights summing to ~1.0). Returns a capital-weighted composite (`composite_score`), a per-provider breakdown, counterparty concentration, and elevated-exposure warnings. The composite is an ANALYTICAL aggregate of the providers' ACI Risk
